Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

At MRA Bakers, we offer a variety of delicious cakes. Here are some of our popular options:

1. **Choco Fudge** - Chocolate sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched and topped with pure melted chocolate and chocolate fudge, decorated with red cherries and chocolate shavings. **Price:** ₹999.00 ![Choco Fudge](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_121034.png)

2. **Oreo Delight** - Vanilla sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched and topped with vanilla fresh cream and chocolate truffle, garnished with Oreo biscuits. **Price:** ₹949.00 ![Oreo Delight](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_123607.png)

3. **Tiramisu** - Vanilla sponge cake layered with finger biscuits dipped in espresso and topped with rich tiramisu. **Price:** ₹1099.00 ![Tiramisu](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_123648.png)

4. **Red Velvet** - Red sponge soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched and topped with vanilla fresh cream and decorated with red cherries. **Price:** ₹949.00 ![Red Velvet](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_114400.png)

5. **Butterscotch** - Vanilla sponge cake soaked in sugar syrup, sandwiched and topped with butterscotch fresh cream. **Price:** ₹949.00 ![Butterscotch](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-01-06_114734.png)
